beats.label: S1 · The heir comes home
beats.text: Wynonna returns to Purgatory for her uncle's funeral and learns the Earp curse is real: Wyatt's 77 outlaws resurrect as Revenants, and she is the new heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire premise the reader must carry into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Peacemaker and Doc
beats.text: Black Badge agent Xavier Dolls recruits her to hunt the Revenants with Wyatt's gun, Peacemaker. Immortal gunslinger Doc Holliday joins as an uneasy ally.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the two men who define Wynonna's next three seasons.

beats.label: S1 · The Seven
beats.text: Wynonna picks off the Seven — the Revenants who killed her father — while Waverly starts dating deputy Nicole Haught.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Waverly/Nicole is the show's second most central relationship going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Willa is alive
beats.text: A cult member called Eve turns out to be Willa, Wynonna's presumed-dead older sister and the original Earp heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Willa reveal drives the season's endgame and colours the S2 opener.

beats.label: S1 · The Lead
beats.text: Willa remembers she was Bobo's lover: as the Lead, if she willingly leaves the Triangle with a Revenant, the curse ends and Purgatory dies with it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the final act and sets the stakes of the barrier crossing.

beats.label: S1 · Poison at the party
beats.text: Bobo poisons the town party and orders Wynonna hunted; he and Willa flee for the barrier, but Peacemaker rejects Willa and Wynonna is forced to shoot her sister dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pivot where Wynonna loses her sister and commits the season's defining act.

beats.label: S1 · What crossed the line
beats.text: Black Badge takes Dolls into custody; Wynonna kills Bobo before he can be tortured, and Waverly touches black tentacle ooze that leaves her changed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: These two threads are literally the S2 premiere's opening problems.

cliffhanger.text: Wynonna has killed Bobo but lost Dolls to a Black Badge black site. Her sister Waverly, contaminated by residue from the barrier creature, has just raised a gun at her.
questions: Can Wynonna get Dolls back from Black Badge?
What has crawled inside Waverly after she touched the ooze?
What did Juan Carlo mean when he warned that breaking the barrier had a price?

characters.name: Wynonna Earp
characters.line: The Earp heir; carries Peacemaker; killed her older sister at the barrier to keep the curse in place.

characters.name: Waverly Earp
characters.line: Wynonna's researcher younger sister; dating deputy Nicole; ended the season touched by something inhuman.

characters.name: Doc Holliday
characters.line: 178-year-old gunslinger made immortal by Constance Clootie; uneasy ally and occasional lover to Wynonna.

characters.name: Xavier Dolls
characters.line: Black Badge agent who runs the team; needs a serum that turns him into a fire-breathing berserker; taken into custody.

characters.name: Nicole Haught
characters.line: Purgatory sheriff's deputy dating Waverly, now knowingly on the supernatural team.

characters.name: Bobo Del Rey
characters.line: Revenant leader who orchestrated the season and was killed by Wynonna at the barrier.

characters.name: Willa Earp
characters.line: The original Earp heir; returned as an amnesiac cult member, remembered she loved Bobo, and was shot dead by Wynonna.

characters.name: Constance Clootie
characters.line: Witch who made Doc immortal and cursed the Earps; buried alive up to her neck in salt.

beats.label: S2 · Black Badge was a lie
beats.text: Wynonna breaks Dolls out of Black Badge, which is then exposed as never having been a real agency; the team is now on its own.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the institutional backing and sets the DIY tone for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S2 · The Widows arrive
beats.text: Twin demon widows arrive hunting three seals that will free the ancient demon Bulshar Clootie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonists and the villain who becomes S3's big bad.

beats.label: S2 · Possessed and pregnant
beats.text: The demon inside Waverly jumps to Wynonna and back before the team can burn it out; Wynonna quietly finds out she is pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pregnancy sets up the season's final act; the possession opens the door to Waverly's later transformations.

beats.label: S2 · The vision quest
beats.text: A vision quest reveals Wyatt Earp shot Bulshar through his framed friend Bobo, and the third seal is Constance Clootie's ring, which Doc has been carrying.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes Bobo's whole backstory and locates the seal the villains need.

beats.label: S2 · Wynonna unmade
beats.text: An Iron Witch wipes Wynonna out of existence in revenge; Bobo, who remembers her, tells Waverly about the spell so she can break it and restore reality.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bobo remembering Wynonna cements him as more than a straight villain going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Bulshar unsealed
beats.text: Beth obtains the third seal and Bulshar is freed; Wynonna kills the Widows with a special bullet, and Waverly quietly learns she is not fully Earp.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both the S3 villain and the S3 mystery of Waverly's parentage are set in motion here.

beats.label: S2 · Alice and the ring
beats.text: Wynonna gives birth to Alice — Doc's daughter — and sends her out of the Triangle for safety, then leaves Purgatory to meet her mother. Nicole ends up holding Bulshar's ring.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sends the baby offscreen, points Wynonna at Michelle, and plants Bulshar's ring on the wrong finger.

cliffhanger.text: Bulshar Clootie is loose and his ring sits on Nicole's finger. Baby Alice is being raised outside the Triangle by Perry, and Wynonna is on the road to a mother she barely knows.
questions: What does the freed Bulshar want, and why is his ring drawn back to Nicole?
Who is Waverly's father Julian, and what does not being an Earp make her?
What can Wynonna's imprisoned mother Michelle tell her that Bobo and Constance would not?

characters.name: Wynonna Earp
characters.line: Heir and new mother; sent baby Alice away and is leaving Purgatory to meet her mother.

characters.name: Waverly Earp
characters.line: Wynonna's half-sister; DNA has confirmed she is not fully Earp.

characters.name: Doc Holliday
characters.line: Father of Alice; broke off with revenant Rosita after her betrayal.

characters.name: Xavier Dolls
characters.line: Rescued from Black Badge and back on the team; still tethered to his serum.

characters.name: Nicole Haught
characters.line: Sheriff's deputy dating Waverly, unknowingly wearing Bulshar's ring.

characters.name: Jeremy Chetri
characters.line: Ex-BBD scientist now folded into the team as its tech and chemistry.

characters.name: Bobo Del Rey
characters.line: Resurrected and briefly institutionalised; thrown back down the well by Doc.

characters.name: Rosita
characters.line: Doc's ex-girlfriend, revealed as a Revenant, tried to sell baby Alice and vanished.

characters.name: Alice Michelle
characters.line: Doc and Wynonna's newborn daughter, being raised outside the Triangle for her safety.

beats.label: S3 · Dolls falls
beats.text: Vampires from the Cult of Bulshar arrive in Purgatory; Dolls dies protecting the team from a demon at the cliff where Peacemaker fell.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes one of the original three leads and reshapes the team for good.

beats.label: S3 · Julian is an angel
beats.text: Wynonna's mother Michelle escapes prison; Bobo tells Wynonna that Waverly's father Julian is an angel, which is why Peacemaker recognises her too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the S2-ending parentage question and reframes what Waverly is.

beats.label: S3 · Bulshar rises
beats.text: Bulshar Clootie rises in the woods and demands Wynonna's blood to open a staircase to the Garden of Eden; Bobo defects to him as his lieutenant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names both the villain's goal and the geography of the season's ending.

beats.label: S3 · Charlie is Julian
beats.text: A firefighter named Charlie beds Wynonna and is quietly revealed to be Julian himself, Waverly's angel father returned in the flesh.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recontextualises a whole season's romance and gives Julian a body to be killed with.

beats.label: S3 · Doc turns
beats.text: Doc's long-lost wife Contessa returns and turns him into a vampire, which he hides from Wynonna until it fractures the team.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Doc enters S4 having been a vampire and having a wife on the board.

beats.label: S3 · The curse breaks
beats.text: In the final battle Bulshar takes Wynonna's blood to break the Earp curse and every Revenant vanishes; Waverly then names Wynonna wielder of the Peacemaker sword and she kills him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The 200-year premise of the show ends here; S4 starts in the world this creates.

beats.label: S3 · Into the Garden
beats.text: Bobo kills Julian; tree-roots drag Waverly into the Garden of Eden and Doc dives in after her. Someone has carved VALDEZ inside the Earp house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: These are the exact three problems the S4 premiere opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Wynonna has broken the Earp curse and every Revenant with it, but Waverly is trapped in the Garden of Eden and Doc has followed her in. The word VALDEZ is carved inside the homestead — a message from somebody who knows what comes next.
questions: How does Wynonna get into the Garden of Eden to bring Waverly and Doc back?
With the curse gone and the Revenants vanished, what still walks in Purgatory?

characters.name: Wynonna Earp
characters.line: Broke the two-hundred-year Earp curse with the reforged Peacemaker sword; alone at the homestead.

characters.name: Waverly Earp
characters.line: Confirmed part-angel through her father Julian; trapped inside the Garden of Eden.

characters.name: Doc Holliday
characters.line: Was turned into a vampire by his old wife Contessa; has gone into the Garden after Waverly.

characters.name: Nicole Haught
characters.line: New sheriff of Purgatory.

characters.name: Jeremy Chetri
characters.line: Team scientist and, with Waverly gone, the one person in Purgatory who can still identify a threat.

characters.name: Randy Nedley
characters.line: Retired sheriff; quietly protects the team and is Wynonna's only ally at the homestead.

characters.name: Xavier Dolls
characters.line: Dead; sacrificed himself in the season opener.

characters.name: Contessa
characters.line: Doc's centuries-old vampire wife who came looking for him and is still in Purgatory.

beats.label: S4 · Finding Valdez
beats.text: Wynonna finds the name VALDEZ in Dolls's old files and tracks it to a Black Badge facility, where she rescues teenage Rachel Valdez from a zombie-run wreck.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Rachel, who becomes the season's new lead character.

beats.label: S4 · Eighteen months gone
beats.text: A portal reunites Wynonna with Waverly and Doc from the Garden of Eden — eighteen months have passed in Purgatory, and demons run it now.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the time skip that reshapes every relationship and the town itself.

beats.label: S4 · The Clantons
beats.text: The Clantons, Wyatt Earp's oldest enemies, control demonic reapers through the Swamp Witch Margo; Nicole's secret deal with her burned the Earp homestead down.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonists and reveals Nicole's timeskip guilt.

beats.label: S4 · Peacemaker and a proposal
beats.text: Waverly kills Margo to break Nicole's dark bargain and proposes marriage; Wynonna finds Peacemaker again in a sanctuary of scorned nuns.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both the wedding arc and Wynonna's gun-back arc launch from this hour.

beats.label: S4 · Doc turned against her
beats.text: Cleo Clanton ritually makes Doc her family's heir, forcing him to hunt Wynonna; Waverly's suppressed demon side surfaces and the reapers begin to obey her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both partners lose control at once, setting the final act's problem.

beats.label: S4 · The angel shield
beats.text: Nicole makes herself the angel shield that holds Waverly's demon back, and Doc is freed from his vampirism; the Clanton feud ends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Waverly is walking around at the wedding rather than being contained.

beats.label: S4 · The road out
beats.text: Waverly and Nicole marry at the Earp homestead. Wynonna and Doc drive out of Purgatory together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Where every character actually stands as the story leaves them.

cliffhanger.text: With the Clantons defeated and Waverly and Nicole married, Wynonna and Doc drive out of Purgatory together. The Earp curse is history and, for the first time, so is the family duty.
questions: Where do Wynonna and Doc go, and does baby Alice come back into her life?
How long can Nicole hold Waverly's demon side back on her own?
With Purgatory quiet and the heir gone, who else comes looking for the Peacemaker?

characters.name: Wynonna Earp
characters.line: Leaves Purgatory with Doc at the end of the season.

characters.name: Waverly Earp
characters.line: Married to Nicole; her demon side is contained only by Nicole's angel shield.

characters.name: Nicole Haught
characters.line: Sheriff and Waverly's wife; now the angel shield that holds Waverly's demon in check.

characters.name: Doc Holliday
characters.line: Cured of his vampirism; leaves Purgatory with Wynonna at the end.

characters.name: Rachel Valdez
characters.line: Teenage newcomer, orphaned daughter of a Black Badge scientist, taken in by the team.

characters.name: Jeremy Chetri
characters.line: Team scientist who kept things running through the eighteen-month gap.

characters.name: Randy Nedley
characters.line: Kidnapped and cured of a parasite; still allied and still in Purgatory.

characters.name: Contessa
characters.line: A fellow captive who helps Nicole escape the train and bites a guard.
